name: picker
description: THE PICKER'S THEME (2026-10-04; the chrome round, the flags round, the playhead round, the label round, the open-flag round, then the invalid-flags round): themes/warptempo.json with the chrome as ONE KNOB, its ground #191919 under the chrome rule (`chrome`: Windows 95's proportions, every relief line, the field and the emboss's light copy following the ground; at #191919 the theme warptempo's own row), the canvas #0E0E0E, the ink #A6B9DE (the ink round's latest pick), the outline by its rule ("auto": the 50 % linear-light blend of the ink over the canvas), the flag's face #666699 and its selected face #9999CC (the current design for now, CE01), BOTH FLAG LABELS WHITE (architect 2026-10-04: consistency; `flag_label_sel` #FFFFFF, as the app's built-in `flag_label_selected` since 2026-10-05; program keys of their own, fixed), the selected pair, the selected fill #666666 under the selected text #FFFFFF (the open-flag round's elements), the invalid face #993333 and its selected face #FF6666 (the invalid-flags round's elements, the product's defaults) under the invalid label #FFFFFF (fixed, as the flag labels), the chrome's label #FFFFFF with the field text following it (`@label`: the field ground is the Hilight, a ground-family colour, so its text is the label's case). Exported with --export for tools/palette/picker/: twelve elements in the architect's order of importance (2026-10-04), Chrome (active), Canvas and Ink over the scene `waveform` (the ink round's: the marker stems, the flags, the playhead and row 8's state line switched off), then Unselected Flag and Selected Flag over the scene `flags` (the waveform scene with the stems and the flags on, the fourth flag from the left SELECTED with its payload box the addressed cell, so its stem is bright: the state he meets a selected flag in most). Then Playhead Head and Playhead Stem (architect 2026-10-04: the program's two playhead keys, #8B8B8B and #FCFCFC, the product's defaults) over the scene `playhead` (the flags scene's stems and flags with NO flag selected -- in the app a marker click lands the playhead on it, and a playhead standing on a marker suppresses its own stem -- and the playhead ON at its column, x 293: the head opaque in the tablet geometry, its one-LW outline the label, the stem uniform down the marker lane and the well). Then Label (architect 2026-10-04: the chrome's TEXT colour, a pickable element -- not a black / white switch and not automatic contrast -- starting #FFFFFF; every role the label roots follows it: the menu words, the legend, the clock, the ruler's timestamps, the icons' text ink, the scroll arrow, the playhead head's outline, the state line) over the scene `label` (the waveform scene with row 8's state line ON, the app's label-coloured process line, so the most chrome text shows; the flags stay off, their labels being program keys of their own). Then Selection and Selected Text (architect 2026-10-04: the theme's selected pair, Windows' Hilight / HilightText, starting at #666666 and #FFFFFF) over the scene `open_flag` (the flags scene's stems and flags with the fourth flag's EDITOR OPEN and its whole text selected, as the editor opens: the face the selected face, the black frame, the band the selection under the selected text, the stem the selected face; the fourth flag, x 1816, stays in view right of the panel and its theme strip when the panel opens on the left). Then Unselected Invalid Flag and Selected Invalid Flag (architect 2026-10-04: the invalid face and its selected face, `invalid_face` and `invalid_face_selected` in the product, starting #993333 and #FF6666, each moving its face and its stem as the flags round's two do) over the scene `invalid_flags` (the flags scene's stems and flags with the THIRD and FOURTH flags INVALID and the fourth SELECTED with its payload box the addressed cell, so its stem is bright; the labels fixed white: the invalid label over the unselected invalid face, and over the selected one the ONE selected label `flag_label_sel`, the product's label on both selected faces; both flags, x 1343 and 1816, in view with the panel on the left, the selected one with its theme strip open too). The flag labels, the invalid label and the flag outlines stay fixed roles.
